Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
sim...@iweb.net.au (Simidh) wrote:
> Is it possible for stealth to drop below 0 and if so does it then have to be
> pushed ((0 - X) + (X + 1)) to need intercept again where X equals however
> low below 0 the stealth has become? (Various cards seem to cause -1 stealth or
> in some cases intercept)

Yes(?). Zero is just the default stealth/intercept level. It is not a limiting
factor. Whenever the acting minion's stealth (positive, negative, or zero)
is equalled or exceeded by the blocking minion's intercept (positive,
negative, or zero), then the block will succeed.
